title: Month 12
subtitle: One year. The first birthday is a real milestone, and the next stage starts next month.

baby.development: Your baby may be walking or close to it, says a few words, and can follow simple instructions. They are starting to test what happens when they do something you said not to.

you.body: If you are breastfeeding, you can keep going for as long as you both want. If you are formula feeding, the switch to whole milk happens now.
you.mind: A year is a long time and you did it. The toddler stage is different: more opinion, more movement, and the same amount of love.

coreActions.title: Go to the twelve-month visit
coreActions.why: This is the visit with the most decisions in it, and the one where the next year's schedule gets set.
coreActions.detail: The US schedule at twelve months is MMR, varicella, Hib, and PCV, and hepatitis A and B depending on what was given earlier. Ask about whole milk, iron, and a lead test. Ask about walking and words if either is behind.

coreActions.title: Switch to whole milk and drop the bottle
coreActions.why: Whole milk has the fat a one-year-old needs, and the bottle is the habit that causes tooth decay after a year.
coreActions.detail: Two to three cups a day, in an open cup or a straw cup. Mix with formula over a week if needed. No bottle at bedtime. Milk is a drink, not a meal replacement, so it comes with food rather than instead of it.

coreActions.title: Know that tantrums are starting, and they are not defiance
coreActions.why: A one-year-old has big feelings and no words for them. The behaviour is the communication, not a challenge to your authority.
coreActions.detail: Name the feeling, stay nearby, and do not try to reason with a screaming toddler. It peaks between eighteen months and three years. Hitting and biting are common and are handled by a calm no and a redirect, not by punishment.

alsoKnow.title: The toddler stage starts next month
alsoKnow.body: The guide switches from months to the toddler timeline. The cadence slows down, because a month is a long time at this age.

alsoKnow.title: First dental visit by the first birthday
alsoKnow.body: A check by the first tooth or the first birthday, whichever comes first. It is short, it is mostly a look, and it sets up the habit.

redFlags.text: Choking — cannot breathe, cough, or make a sound
A fever over 100.4°F with unusual sleepiness or a rash
Feeling hopeless, or thoughts of harming yourself or the child
